title: Electoral results affect beliefs about the past: Evidence from Chile
title_zh: 选举结果影响对过去的认知：来自智利的证据
title_primary: 选举结果影响对过去的认知：来自智利的证据
title_secondary: Electoral results affect beliefs about the past: Evidence from Chile
authors: Nicolás Ajzenman, Patricio Dominguez, Lucas M. Novaes
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can electoral outcomes shape voters' perceptions of the past? We argue that electoral outcomes provide informational cues that prompt voters to reinterpret prior conditions, shifting the benchmarks on which accountability rests. We focus on perceptions of crime, a valence issue that voters likely take into account when choosing any candidate. We propose that perceptions of crime change immediately after an election, as voters reinterpret prior conditions through the lens of the relevance of crime in the winning candidate's platform. We leverage the timing of opinion surveys in Chile on public security to compare respondents interviewed just before and just after local elections, across municipalities where a right-wing mayor narrowly won versus narrowly lost. We show that shortly after a local right-wing candidate wins by a small margin, respondents report that their neighborhood, state, and country are less safe than those who answered the same survey a few days before the election. Victimization, which is unlikely to be misremembered, does not vary across groups of respondents. The findings show that this shift in perceptions directly affects electoral accountability: When political outcomes shape beliefs about past performance, accountability itself becomes endogenous to electoral results.
abstract_zh: 选举结果能否塑造选民对过去的认知？选举结果可以提供信息线索，促使选民重新解读先前状况，从而改变问责所依赖的基准。我们通过犯罪感知这一与任何候选人都相关的价值议题来考察此问题。我们比较了智利地方选举前后受访者的回答，涵盖右翼市长以微弱优势获胜与落败的市镇。在右翼以微弱优势获胜后不久接受调查的个体，更倾向于报告犯罪率上升，尽管自我报告的受害经历并未改变。我们的发现表明，问责本身对选举结果具有内生性。

title: Culture and Social Organizations in the Great Reversal: Europe and China, 1000-2000
title_zh: 大逆转中的文化与社会组织：欧洲与中国，1000-2000年
title_primary: 大逆转中的文化与社会组织：欧洲与中国，1000-2000年
title_secondary: Culture and Social Organizations in the Great Reversal: Europe and China, 1000-2000
authors: Avner Greif, Joel Mokyr, Guido Tabellini
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why did the industrial revolution occur in Europe and not in China, despite China being well ahead of Europe in terms of economic and technological achievements several centuries earlier? We revisit this long-standing question from a new perspective. We emphasize the importance of the different social organizations that diffused in these two parts of the world in the centuries that preceded the industrial revolution: kin-based organizations in China, vs corporations in Europe. We explain their cultural origins, and discuss how these different organizations shaped the evolution of legal systems, political institutions and human capital accumulation in these two parts of the world. Our main argument is that European corporations played a crucial role in the scientific and technological innovations that ultimately led to the industrial revolution.
abstract_zh: 工业革命为何发生在欧洲而非中国，尽管中国在数个世纪前在经济和技术成就上已远超欧洲？我们从新的视角重新审视这一长期存在的问题。我们强调在工业革命前的几个世纪里，这两种文明中传播的不同社会组织的重要性：中国以亲属关系为基础的组织，欧洲则为企业组织。我们阐释了这些组织的文化起源，并讨论它们如何塑造了这两个地区法律制度、政治制度及人力资本积累的演变。我们的核心论点是，欧洲的企业组织在最终引发工业革命的科技革新中扮演了关键角色。

title: Staying in power: how does political continuity shape debt?
title_zh: 维持权力：政治连续性如何影响债务？
title_primary: 维持权力：政治连续性如何影响债务？
title_secondary: Staying in power: how does political continuity shape debt?
authors: Jaime Bonet-Morón, Jhorland Ayala-García, Jorge Guerra-España
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between political continuity and public municipal debt in Colombia, highlighting how political cycles influence fiscal behavior at subnational level. Unlike national cycles, local political dynamics, marked by consecutive electoral victories of the same party, significantly impact fiscal policy and debt accumulation. Using a Kink Regression Discontinuity design, we explore the effects of these electoral outcomes on public financial debt. Our results show that an additional percentage point in the mayoral win margin increases municipal per capita debt by 2 thousand COP, with larger effects in smaller municipalities and evidence of amplification where the governing party has stronger council representation. The effect strengthens over time, is consistent in sign and magnitude with a complementary difference-in-differences strategy, and remains robust to alternative bandwidth specifications, permutation-based tests, and time-placebo exercises.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政治连续性与哥伦比亚公共市政债务之间的关系，强调了政治周期如何影响地方层面的财政行为。与国家级周期不同，以同一政党连续赢得选举为标志的地方政治动态，显著影响财政政策与债务积累。利用拐点回归不连续设计，我们考察了这些选举结果对公共财政债务的影响。结果显示，市长获胜优势每增加一个百分点，市政人均债务增加2000哥伦比亚比索，在较小城市中效应更为显著，并且有证据表明，在执政党拥有更强议会代表性的地方，该效应会被放大。这一效应随时间增强，其符号和大小与补充性的双重差分策略一致，并且对替代带宽设定、基于置换的检验以及时间安慰剂测试保持稳健。

title: Workplace Incentives and Organizational Learning
title_zh: 工作场所激励与组织学习
title_primary: 工作场所激励与组织学习
title_secondary: Workplace Incentives and Organizational Learning
authors: Francesco Amodio, Miguel Martinez-Carrasco, Johanna Glauber, Tobias Kretschmer, Mikhail Drugov 等
official: 官方在线 2020-11-26 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies learning within organizations when incentives change. We use a simple principal-agent model to show how, in the presence of imperfect information over the shape of the production function, workers' effort choice changes over time as information is disclosed and processed. We also show that changing incentives can trigger this learning process. We test this prediction using personnel data from an egg production plant in Peru. Exploiting a sudden change in the contract parameters, we find that workers learn from each other over the shape of the production function. This adjustment process is costly for the firm.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当激励发生变化时组织内部的学习行为。我们运用一个简单的委托-代理模型，展示了在生产函数形态信息不完全的情况下，随着信息的披露与处理，工人的努力选择如何随时间演变。同时，我们也证明了激励的变化能够触发这一学习过程。我们利用秘鲁一家蛋品生产厂的员工数据对这一预测进行了检验。通过利用合同参数的突然变动，我们发现工人之间会就生产函数的形态相互学习。这一调整过程对企业而言成本高昂。

title: A Nonparametric Framework for Online Stochastic Matching with Correlated Arrivals
title_zh: 具有相关到达的在线随机匹配的非参数框架
title_primary: 具有相关到达的在线随机匹配的非参数框架
title_secondary: A Nonparametric Framework for Online Stochastic Matching with Correlated Arrivals
authors: Ali Aouad, Will Ma
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The design of online algorithms for matching markets and revenue management settings is usually bound by the assumption that the demand process is formed by a fixed-length sequence of queries with unknown types, each drawn independently. This notion of serial independence implies that the demand of each type, that is, the number of queries of a given type, has low variance and is approximately Poisson distributed. This paper proposes a nonparametric framework for modeling arrival sequences in online stochastic matching that departs from the serial independent assumption. We propose two models, Indep and Correl, that capture different forms of serial correlations by combining a nonparametric distribution for the demand with standard assumptions on the arrival patterns: adversarial or random order. The Indep model can capture arbitrary serial correlations within each customer type but assumes cross-sectional independence across types, whereas the Correl model captures common shocks across customer types. We demonstrate that fluid relaxations, which rely solely on demand expectations, have arbitrarily bad performance guarantees. In contrast, we develop new algorithms that achieve optimal (constant factor) performance guarantees in each model. Our mathematical analysis includes tighter linear programming (LP) relaxations that leverage distribution knowledge and a new lossless randomized LP rounding scheme for Indep. We test our new LP relaxations and rounding scheme in simulations on real and synthetic data and find that they consistently outperform well-established matching algorithms, especially on real data sequences that exhibit greater demand variance. This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424 .
abstract_zh: 在线匹配市场和收益管理环境中在线算法的设计通常受制于一个假设，即需求过程由一系列固定长度的查询构成，这些查询的类型未知且各自独立抽取。这种序列独立的概念意味着每种类型的需求，即给定类型的查询数量，具有低方差且近似服从泊松分布。本文提出了一种非参数框架，用于建模在线随机匹配中的到达序列，该框架偏离了序列独立的假设。我们提出了两个模型，Indep和Correl，通过将需求的非参数分布与到达模式的标准假设（对抗性或随机顺序）相结合，捕捉不同形式的序列相关性。Indep模型可以捕捉每种客户类型内的任意序列相关性，但假设跨类型截面独立，而Correl模型则捕捉跨客户类型的共同冲击。我们证明，仅依赖需求期望的流体松弛具有任意差的性能保证。相比之下，我们开发了新算法，在每个模型中实现了最优（常数因子）性能保证。我们的数学分析包括利用分布知识的更紧的线性规划（LP）松弛，以及针对Indep的一种新的无损随机LP舍入方案。我们在真实和合成数据上通过模拟测试了我们的新LP松弛和舍入方案，发现它们始终优于成熟的匹配算法，尤其是在表现出更大需求方差的真实数据序列上。本文由Itai Ashlagi接受，属于收益管理和市场分析领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424获取。

title: Urban agriculture as a land-use policy instrument for protecting peri-urban agricultural land: A grid-based analysis from Erzurum, Türkiye
title_zh: 城市农业作为保护城郊农业用地的土地利用政策工具：来自土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆的基于网格的分析
title_primary: 城市农业作为保护城郊农业用地的土地利用政策工具：来自土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆的基于网格的分析
title_secondary: Urban agriculture as a land-use policy instrument for protecting peri-urban agricultural land: A grid-based analysis from Erzurum, Türkiye
authors: Selvi Karasungur, Merve Yavaş
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Uncontrolled urban expansion places increasing pressure on natural resources and poses a significant threat to agricultural production. The loss of agricultural land negatively affects food security and ecosystem services, while rising carbon emissions further exacerbate environmental challenges. In this context, the protection of fertile agricultural lands surrounding cities is critical for sustainable food production. Urban agriculture has emerged as an alternative approach that supports local food production, economic viability, and environmental sustainability. This study examines the suitability of agricultural lands located on the urban fringe of Erzurum for urban agriculture as a response to urban sprawl. The study area, covering selected neighbourhoods in the western part of Erzurum, was divided into 1 × 1 km grid cells. Spatial analyses were conducted for each grid cell based on seven main parameters and twenty-three sub-criteria. An agricultural suitability synthesis map was generated according to the cumulative impact scores derived from these parameters. Rather than limiting the analysis to suitability identification, the spatial results were translated into eight planning-oriented urban agriculture typologies targeting different user groups by integrating suitability outcomes with existing land-use and functional characteristics. The findings indicate that 848 ha of land in Erzurum’s urban periphery exhibit very high suitability for urban agriculture, while 1385 ha demonstrate high suitability. Overall, the study demonstrates that urban agriculture can function as a strategic land-use policy instrument by linking spatial suitability assessment with typology-based planning approaches, thereby supporting peri-urban land protection and guiding statutory planning decisions in secondary cities such as Erzurum.
abstract_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张对自然资源施加了日益增长的压力，并对农业生产构成了重大威胁。农地流失对粮食安全和生态系统服务产生负面影响，而碳排放的上升进一步加剧了环境挑战。在此背景下，保护城市周边肥沃农田对于可持续粮食生产至关重要。城市农业已成为一种支持本地粮食生产、经济可行性和环境可持续性的替代途径。本研究考察了埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区农地作为应对城市蔓延的城市农业适宜性。研究区域覆盖埃尔祖鲁姆西部选定的社区，被划分为1×1公里的网格单元。基于七项主要参数和二十三项子标准，对每个网格单元进行了空间分析。根据这些参数得出的累积影响得分，生成了农业适宜性综合图。分析并未局限于适宜性识别，而是通过将适宜性结果与现有土地利用和功能特征相结合，将空间结果转化为面向不同用户群体的八种规划导向型城市农业类型。研究结果表明，埃尔祖鲁姆城市边缘区有848公顷土地对城市农业表现出极高的适宜性，另有1385公顷土地表现出高适宜性。总体而言，本研究证明，通过将空间适宜性评估与基于类型的规划方法相结合，城市农业可以作为一种战略性的土地利用政策工具，从而支持城郊土地保护，并指导埃尔祖鲁姆等次级城市的法定规划决策。

title: Money talks, moderation walks: the centripetal impact of campaign contributions in the U.S. house
title_zh: 金钱说话，温和走开：竞选捐款对美国众议院的向心影响
title_primary: 金钱说话，温和走开：竞选捐款对美国众议院的向心影响
title_secondary: Money talks, moderation walks: the centripetal impact of campaign contributions in the U.S. house
authors: Andrew Christopher Pickering, Mehmet Akif Yardimci
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do campaign contributions polarize legislators or induce moderation? Theory allows for both possibilities, with effects likely varying by donor type. Using data on all contributions received by members of the U.S. House of Representatives from 2001 to 2022, this paper examines how Political Action Committee (PAC) and individual donations affect subsequent roll-call voting behavior. The analysis focuses on within-legislator changes in ideological positioning across congressional terms. The results consistently show that increased contributions are associated with greater moderation on the economic dimension of roll-call voting. Republican legislators shift toward the political center following increases in both PAC and individual donations in the previous congress. Democratic legislators are more ideologically stable, exhibiting relatively modest centrist movement in response to higher levels of individual contributions. Dynamic specifications suggest that these associations accumulate over successive electoral cycles, most robustly for Republican PAC receipts. Additional analysis reveals a dimensional asymmetry: the centripetal pattern is specific to economic voting, while on the social dimension higher fundraising is if anything associated with more extreme positioning among Republicans. Overall, the findings suggest that campaign contributions in the contemporary U.S. House are associated with economic moderation rather than polarization.
abstract_zh: 竞选捐款究竟是使立法者走向极化，还是促使其趋于温和？理论上两种可能性均存在，其效应可能因捐赠者类型而异。本文利用2001年至2022年间美国众议院议员收到的所有捐款数据，考察政治行动委员会（PAC）和个人捐赠对后续唱名表决行为的影响。分析聚焦于议员在国会任期之间意识形态定位的个体内部变化。结果一致表明，捐款增加与唱名表决在经济维度上的更大温和化相关。共和党议员在上一届国会中收到PAC和个人捐赠增加后，会向政治中心靠拢。民主党议员在意识形态上更为稳定，仅在个人捐赠水平较高时表现出相对适度的中间化动向。动态设定表明，这些关联在连续选举周期中累积，其中共和党PAC收入的效果最为稳健。进一步分析揭示了维度上的不对称性：向心模式仅体现在经济投票上，而在社会维度上，筹款增加若有所关联，则与共和党议员更极端的立场相关。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代美国众议院中的竞选捐款与经济温和化相关，而非极化。

title: Humanitarian Action under Market Pressure
title_zh: 市场压力下的人道主义行动
title_primary: 市场压力下的人道主义行动
title_secondary: Humanitarian Action under Market Pressure
authors: Sebastian Axbard, Roar Os Ådland, Reinhard Weisser
official: 官方在线 2025-07-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how firms trade off commercial objectives against humanitarian obligations. Using 1.1 billion ship positions, we study responses to 1,395 distress alerts during the Mediterranean migration crisis. Event-study estimates show that commercial ships are about 90% less likely than equally distant NGO vessels to render assistance within the first five hours. Opportunity costs determined by load and trip destination shape merchant-vessel responses, suggesting competitive pressures suppress prosocial conduct. At the route level, traffic on affected corridors falls by 14% over the subsequent year, consistent with re-routing to reduce expected rescue exposure and, in turn, shifting global trade flows.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业在商业目标与人道主义义务之间如何权衡。利用11亿条船舶位置数据，我们研究了地中海移民危机期间对1,395次遇险警报的响应情况。事件研究估计显示，在最初五小时内，商业船只提供援助的可能性比距离相同的非政府组织船只低约90%。由载货量和航程目的地决定的机会成本塑造了商船的响应行为，这表明竞争压力抑制了亲社会行为。在航线层面，受影响走廊的交通量在随后一年内下降了14%，这与为减少预期救援暴露而重新规划航线一致，并进而改变了全球贸易流向。

title: Competitive Shield or Carbon Burden? Evidence from Equity Market Reactions to CBAM Enforcement
title_zh: 竞争盾牌还是碳负担？来自股票市场对CBAM实施反应的证据
title_primary: 竞争盾牌还是碳负担？来自股票市场对CBAM实施反应的证据
title_secondary: Competitive Shield or Carbon Burden? Evidence from Equity Market Reactions to CBAM Enforcement
authors: Salvatore La Barbera
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines equity market reactions to the enforcement of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) on January 1, 2026. Using an event-study approach on a sample of S&P 500 and STOXX Europe 600 firms, we document three main findings. First, CBAM enforcement is associated with positive aggregate abnormal returns, consistent with the resolution of policy uncertainty. Second, both European firms and CBAM-exposed sectors experience lower post-event returns on average, reflecting compliance costs. Third, and most importantly, the interaction between geography and CBAM exposure shows that the impact of exposure is relatively more favorable for European firms compared to their U.S. counterparts. These results suggest that CBAM is perceived by financial markets as both a carbon burden and a competitive mechanism, with effects concentrated in the short run.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了股票市场对2026年1月1日欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）实施的反应。采用事件研究法，以标普500指数和斯托克欧洲600指数成分股为样本，我们得出三项主要发现。第一，CBAM的实施与正向的总体异常收益相关联，这与政策不确定性的消除相一致。第二，欧洲企业和受CBAM影响的行业在事件后平均回报率较低，反映了合规成本。第三，也是最重要的一点，地理位置与CBAM暴露度之间的交互作用表明，相较于美国同行，暴露度对欧洲企业的影响相对更为有利。这些结果表明，金融市场将CBAM视为一种碳负担和竞争机制，其影响主要集中在短期内。

title: Automation and Unemployment: Help is on the Way
title_zh: 自动化与失业：援助正在路上
title_primary: 自动化与失业：援助正在路上
title_secondary: Automation and Unemployment: Help is on the Way
authors: Hideki Nakamura, Joseph Zeira
official: 官方在线 2018-06-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents a model of technical change that combines two lines of research together. It is a task based model, in which automation turns labor tasks to mechanized ones, and there is also a continuous addition of new labor tasks, as in the expanding variety literature. We impose three simple restrictions on the model. The first is that all new tasks are adopted. The second is that all new automation innovations are adopted and the third is that the share of labor does not converge to zero in the long run. We show that these restrictions imply that unemployment due to automation is expected to converge to zero over time.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种技术变革模型，融合了两条研究路径。该模型基于任务框架，其中自动化将劳动任务转变为机械化任务，同时，正如扩展品种文献所述，新劳动任务也在持续增加。我们对模型施加了三个简单约束：第一，所有新任务均被采纳；第二，所有新自动化创新均被采纳；第三，长期内劳动份额不会趋近于零。我们证明，这些约束意味着由自动化导致的失业预计将随时间收敛至零。

title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
title_zh: 两个选择问题，一个偏差项：实验报名实为伪装的处置选择
title_primary: 两个选择问题，一个偏差项：实验报名实为伪装的处置选择
title_secondary: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
authors: John A. List
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider a referee report containing the sentence: “Assignment to treatment was voluntary, though the authors acknowledge this as a limitation in the conclusion.” The Editor would summarily reject. Now replace “assignment to treatment” with “entry into the experimental sample,” and the sentence describes the modal published experiment. This study shows that both biases are the same mathematical object. The bias from non-random sample entry is the sorting-on-gains term from the classic selection decomposition. Interestingly, they both admit an isomorphic Roy micro-foundation and inverse-Mills characterization. A simple calibration reveals that for the typical experiment, the observed bias can be large. One solution to this bias is to conduct a natural field experiment (NFE). When an NFE is not possible, three alternative reporting practices are offered.
abstract_zh: 考虑一份审稿报告中包含的句子：“治疗分配是自愿的，尽管作者在结论中承认这是局限性。”编辑会立即拒绝。现在将“治疗分配”替换为“进入实验样本”，该句子描述的是典型已发表实验的情况。本研究表明，这两种偏差在数学上是同一对象。非随机样本进入导致的偏差，正是经典选择分解中的收益排序项。有趣的是，两者都允许同构的罗伊微观基础及逆米尔斯函数表征。一个简单的校准显示，对于典型实验而言，观察到的偏差可能很大。解决此偏差的一种方法是进行自然田野实验（NFE）。当无法进行NFE时，本文提供了三种替代性的报告实践。

title: Instrumental variable regression with varying-intensity repeated treatments
title_zh: 变强度重复处理的工具变量回归
title_primary: 变强度重复处理的工具变量回归
title_secondary: Instrumental variable regression with varying-intensity repeated treatments
authors: Jaerim Choi, Dakyung Seong, Shu Shen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Instrumental variable models with repeated endogenous treatments are popular in empirical research using pooled cross-sectional or short panel datasets. This paper proposes a novel semi-parametric approach that explicitly considers 1) path dependency in the contemporaneous treatment effect and 2) a direct carryover effect from past treatments. We demonstrate that when either of these new features is present, the standard two-stage least squares estimator is generally invalid. We apply the proposed semi-parametric estimation and inference approach to revisit the seminal work of Acemoglu et al. (2016). Using industry-level data, we find that the magnitude of contemporaneous impacts of increased Chinese import competition on US manufacturing employment depends on an industry’s past import exposure. In particular, industries with larger trade shocks in the 1990s tend to experience stronger impacts from contemporaneous trade shocks in the 2000s.
abstract_zh: 含有重复内生处理变量的工具变量模型在利用混合截面数据或短面板数据的实证研究中颇为流行。本文提出了一种新颖的半参数方法，明确考虑了1)同期处理效应中的路径依赖性，以及2)过去处理带来的直接延续效应。我们证明，当这两种新特征中的任意一种存在时，标准的两阶段最小二乘估计量通常无效。我们将所提出的半参数估计与推断方法应用于重新审视Acemoglu等人(2016)的开创性工作。利用行业层面数据，我们发现中国进口竞争加剧对美国制造业就业的同期影响幅度取决于该行业过去的进口暴露程度。特别是，在1990年代经历较大贸易冲击的行业，往往在2000年代对同期贸易冲击的反应更为强烈。

title: Capacity and Product Market Competition: Measuring Market Power in a 'Fat-Cat' Industry
title_zh: 产能与产品市场竞争：衡量“肥猫”行业的市场势力
title_primary: 产能与产品市场竞争：衡量“肥猫”行业的市场势力
title_secondary: Capacity and Product Market Competition: Measuring Market Power in a 'Fat-Cat' Industry
authors: Lars Hendrik Röller, Robin Siekles, Ritvana Rrukaj, Frode Steen, Thummim Cho 等
official: 官方在线 1998-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper we specify and estimate a structural model which accounts for competition in two variables: capacity and prices. The model has a two-stage set-up. In the first stage firms make capacity decisions followed by a product-differentiated, price-setting game in the second stage. Since costs are endogenized through the first stage, this has important implications for the measurement of market power in the product market. In particular, simpler one-stage specifications would result in a bias in the measurement of market power, which can be linked to the taxonomy for two-stage games given in Fudenberg and Tirole (1984). We then estimate this model ? demand, cost (short- and long-run), and conduct ? for the European airline industry using data for the period 1976?90. We perform a number of specification tests and reject a simple one-stage specification in favour of our two-stage set-up. In particular, we find that empirically the game is consistent with a fat-cat strategy. In other words, European airlines over-invest in capacities in order to be less aggressive. Moreover, we find that some degree of market power in the product market exists. Market power in the two-stage set-up is significantly lower than in the more widely employed one-stage specification, however, which is consistent with the direction of bias in fat-cat games. This illustrates that firms? market power in the product market is significantly overestimated whenever capacity competition is not accounted for.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并估计了一个考虑产能与价格双重竞争的结构性模型。该模型采用两阶段设定：第一阶段企业进行产能决策，随后在第二阶段展开产品差异化定价博弈。由于第一阶段内生化成本，这对产品市场市场势力的测度产生重要影响。具体而言，更简化的单阶段模型会导致市场势力测度出现偏差，这种偏差可关联至Fudenberg和Tirole（1984）提出的两阶段博弈分类体系。我们利用1976-1990年欧洲航空业数据，对模型的需求、成本（短期与长期）及市场行为进行估计。通过一系列设定检验，我们拒绝了单阶段模型，支持两阶段设定。实证结果表明，该博弈符合"肥猫策略"特征——欧洲航空公司通过过度投资产能来降低竞争强度。此外，产品市场存在一定程度的市场势力，但两阶段设定下的市场势力显著低于广泛使用的单阶段模型，这与肥猫博弈的偏差方向一致。这揭示出：若未考虑产能竞争，产品市场中的企业市场势力将被显著高估。

title: The Geography of Child Penalties and Gender Norms: A Pseudo-Event Study Approach
title_zh: 儿童惩罚的地理分布与性别规范：一项伪事件研究法分析
title_primary: 儿童惩罚的地理分布与性别规范：一项伪事件研究法分析

authors: Kleven, Henrik
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a pseudo-event study approach for estimating child penalties using cross-sectional data. The approach produces estimates that align closely with those obtained from true event studies using panel data and is statistically more precise. This allows for providing more granular evidence and study mechanisms. The paper presents a detailed investigation of the variation in child penalties across time, geography, and demographic/cultural groups in the US. There is large variation in these dimensions. Using a variety of approaches—including epidemiological studies of movers and immigrants—the paper finds that gender norms have sizable effects on child penalties.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于横截面数据估计子女惩罚的伪事件研究方法。该方法得出的估计值与使用面板数据的真实事件研究结果高度一致，且统计精度更高。这为提供更细粒度的证据和研究机制创造了条件。本文详细考察了美国不同时期、不同地区以及不同人口/文化群体中子女惩罚的差异。这些维度上存在显著差异。通过多种方法——包括针对迁移者和移民的流行病学研究——本文发现，性别规范对子女惩罚具有显著影响。

title: Can zoning reform reduce housing costs? Evidence from rents in Auckland
title_zh: 分区改革能否降低住房成本？来自奥克兰租金的证据
title_primary: 分区改革能否降低住房成本？来自奥克兰租金的证据
title_secondary: Can zoning reform reduce housing costs? Evidence from rents in Auckland
authors: Ryan Greenaway‐McGrevy, Yun So
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Zoning reform is increasingly advocated to redress unaffordable housing, but few real‐world examples demonstrate its efficacy. However, Auckland recently upzoned approximately three‐quarters of its residential land, precipitating a housing construction boom. We investigate whether the reform reduced housing costs, adopting a synthetic control method to estimate rental prices in Auckland under the counterfactual of no zoning change. Eight years after the reform, the synthetic control under our preferred empirical specification implies that rents decreased by 23% due to the reform. These findings are robust across a range of specifications and support the proposition that widespread upzoning can enhance housing affordability.
abstract_zh: 摘要 分区改革日益被倡导以解决住房负担能力问题，但很少有现实案例证明其有效性。然而，奥克兰最近对其约四分之三的住宅用地进行了重新分区，引发了住房建设热潮。我们采用合成控制法，在未发生分区变化的反事实情境下估算奥克兰的租金价格，以研究该改革是否降低了住房成本。改革实施八年后，我们偏好的实证设定下的合成控制结果表明，租金因改革下降了23%。这些发现在一系列设定下均保持稳健，并支持了广泛重新分区可提升住房可负担性的论点。

title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
title_zh: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备
title_primary: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备
title_secondary: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
authors: Joshua Aizenman, Jamel Saadaoui, Gazi Salah Uddin, Naoki Yago
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the role of foreign exchange and gold reserves in mitigating the US monetary policy spillovers to exchange rates at times of geopolitical fragmentation and de-dollarization. US dollar reserves mitigate depreciation driven by US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller exchange-rate responses, though less strongly than dollar reserves, suggesting novel complementarity between dollar and gold reserves. Moreover, the estimated effects of dollar and gold reserves are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines. These findings are consistent with recent large-scale purchases and sales of gold reserves by emerging economies amid sanctions-related restrictions and geopolitical concerns about access to dollar liquidity. Our results suggest that not only the aggregate volume but also the composition of foreign exchange and gold reserves and access to dollar liquidity facilities are empirically relevant for exchange-rate responses to US monetary shocks. Finally, we exploit cross-country heterogeneity and show that countries with large dollar exposure exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses when dollar and gold reserve holdings are larger.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘政治碎片化和去美元化背景下，外汇储备与黄金储备在缓解美国货币政策对汇率溢出效应中的作用。美元储备能够缓解由美国货币紧缩引发的本币贬值，而非美元储备则不具备这一效果。黄金储备同样与较小的汇率波动幅度相关，但其作用弱于美元储备，这表明美元储备与黄金储备之间存在新颖的互补关系。此外，美元储备与黄金储备的估计效应主要集中在未持有货币互换和回购额度的国家。这些发现与新兴经济体因制裁相关限制及对美元流动性获取的地缘政治担忧而大规模买卖黄金储备的近期实践相一致。我们的结果表明，不仅外汇与黄金储备的总量，其构成以及美元流动性便利的可及性，在实证层面均与汇率对美国货币冲击的反应相关。最后，我们利用跨国异质性分析发现，在美元敞口较大的国家中，当美元储备与黄金储备持有量较高时，其汇率波动幅度更小。

title: Classical Matching via Network Formation
title_zh: 基于网络形成的经典匹配
title_primary: 基于网络形成的经典匹配
title_secondary: Classical Matching via Network Formation
authors: Evan Sadler
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite addressing similar underlying questions, the literatures on network formation and matching have evolved more or less independently. This paper offers a common framework, studying a general model of network formation without externalities—equivalently, a one-sided many-to-many matching model. I give conditions for the existence and uniqueness of stable graphs, I prove a rural hospital theorem, and I highlight a link-by-link conflict of interest across different stable graphs. Special cases contain and extend classic results for the roommate problem and two-sided matching markets. An iterated deletion algorithm adapted from Gutin et al. (2023) furnishes a crucial tool, reducing network formation games to a normal form with helpful properties.
abstract_zh: 尽管网络形成与匹配的相关文献探讨了相似的根本性问题，但它们的发展路径大致上相互独立。本文提出一个统一框架，研究无外部性的网络形成一般模型——等价于单边多对多匹配模型。我给出了稳定图存在性与唯一性的条件，证明了乡村医院定理，并揭示了不同稳定图之间逐链接的利益冲突。特例涵盖并扩展了室友问题和双边匹配市场的经典结果。借鉴自Gutin等人（2023）的迭代删除算法提供了一个关键工具，将网络形成博弈简化为具有有益性质的规范形式。

title: Investment timing and cash management with time-inconsistent preferences
title_zh: 时间不一致偏好下的投资时机与现金管理
title_primary: 时间不一致偏好下的投资时机与现金管理
title_secondary: Investment timing and cash management with time-inconsistent preferences
authors: Miao Liu, Pengfei Luo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of investment timing and liquidity management for a financially constrained all-equity firm whose entrepreneur has time-inconsistent preferences. We provide closed-form solutions for the equity value before and after investment and for the optimal investment threshold. We find that entrepreneur’s time inconsistency delays investment and increases the firm’s cash holdings for investment, which provides a potential theoretical explanation for why firms hold substantial cash. In addition, the investment financing mix violates the pecking order when the degree of time inconsistency is low: firms issue external equity even when internal funds are available. When the degree of time inconsistency is high, investment is financed entirely with internal cash, which aligns with the predictions of the pecking order.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态模型，研究财务受限的全权益企业在企业家具有时间不一致偏好时的投资时机与流动性管理问题。我们提供了投资前后股权价值的闭式解以及最优投资阈值的闭式解。研究发现，企业家的时间不一致性会延迟投资并增加企业为投资持有的现金量，这为解释企业为何持有大量现金提供了潜在的理论依据。此外，当时间不一致程度较低时，投资融资组合违背了啄序理论：即使内部资金充足，企业也会发行外部股权。当时间不一致程度较高时，投资完全由内部现金融资，这与啄序理论的预测一致。

title: Reference-dependent choice bracketing
title_zh: 参考依赖的选择分组
title_primary: 参考依赖的选择分组
title_secondary: Reference-dependent choice bracketing
authors: Pauline Vorjohann
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I derive a model of choice bracketing from two behavioral axioms in an expected utility framework. The first behavioral axiom establishes a link between narrow bracketing and correlation neglect. The second behavioral axiom identifies the reference point as the connector between broad and narrow preferences. The narrow bracketer is characterized by an inability to process changes from the reference point in different dimensions simultaneously. As a result, her tradeoffs between dimensions are distorted. She evaluates dimensions in isolation, implying a disregard for how they affect one another. When evaluating a dimension, she remains anchored to the reference point in the respective other dimension. This implies that she mistakenly perceives preference interactions in relation to the reference point. I present applications to portfolio choice, consumption bundle choice, and an exchange economy.
abstract_zh: 我在期望效用框架下，从两个行为公理推导出一个选择分框模型。第一个行为公理建立了窄分框与相关性忽视之间的联系。第二个行为公理将参考点识别为宽偏好与窄偏好之间的连接器。窄分框者的特征在于无法同时处理来自参考点在不同维度上的变化。因此，她在各维度之间的权衡被扭曲了。她孤立地评估各个维度，意味着忽视了它们之间的相互影响。在评估某一维度时，她仍锚定于另一相应维度上的参考点。这导致她错误地感知了与参考点相关的偏好交互作用。我将此模型应用于投资组合选择、消费束选择以及交换经济中。

title: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
title_zh: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争
title_primary: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争
title_secondary: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
authors: Bård Harstad, Katinka Holtsmark
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了关注气候的天然气生产商面临的一个根本性困境及时间不一致性问题。短期内，增加产量以超越煤炭颇具吸引力。然而，当这一政策被预期到时，可再生能源投资将减少，最终排放量可能上升。当天然气生产商无法预先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。应用于欧洲的模拟版本验证了“天然气陷阱”在数量上的重要性。我们讨论了这一结果的稳健性及可能的解决方案，范围从对可再生能源的直接投资到对天然气勘探与开采征税。

title: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业的季节性与粮食安全
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业的季节性与粮食安全
title_secondary: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Jonas Guthoff, Martin Parlasca, Matin Qaim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many rural households in sub-Saharan Africa rely on rainfed agriculture, meaning that harvests and incomes from farming are highly seasonal. This leads to recurring periods of food insecurity, commonly referred to as lean seasons. Off-farm employment may help mitigate seasonal food insecurity, but evidence on whether it actually does remains scarce. Using panel data from high-frequency phone surveys in Burkina Faso, Malawi, and Uganda, covering the period from 2020–2024, we examine seasonal labor reallocation and implications for food security throughout the year. We find that seasonal labor shifts from farming to off-farm sectors are associated with reduced seasonal food insecurity in most contexts, especially for off-farm wage employment. We also find that in regions where multiple cropping seasons are possible, work in farming is more strongly associated with food security than off-farm wage or self-employment. However, seasonal shifts from farming to other income-generating activities are not very large at the aggregate level, possibly due to lack of rural labor opportunities. These findings highlight that — depending on the context — improvements of opportunities for farming and off-farm employment are important to ensure year-round food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的许多农村家庭依赖雨养农业，这意味着农业收成和收入具有高度季节性。这导致了周期性粮食不安全时期，通常被称为“淡季”。非农就业可能有助于缓解季节性粮食不安全，但关于其是否确实有效的证据仍然稀缺。利用布基纳法索、马拉维和乌干达2020至2024年间高频电话调查的面板数据，我们考察了季节性劳动力重新配置及其对全年粮食安全的影响。我们发现，在大多数情况下，从农业向非农部门的季节性劳动力转移与季节性粮食不安全减少相关，尤其是非农工资就业。我们还发现，在可能有多季种植的地区，农业工作与粮食安全的关联强于非农工资就业或自营就业。然而，从农业向其他创收活动的季节性转移在总体水平上并不显著，可能原因是农村劳动力机会缺乏。这些发现强调，根据具体情境，改善农业和非农就业机会对于确保撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区全年粮食安全至关重要。

title: Unpacking the Links between Conflict and Child Health: Evidence from a Foreign Insurgency
title_zh: 冲突与儿童健康关联解析：来自外国叛乱的证据
title_primary: 冲突与儿童健康关联解析：来自外国叛乱的证据
title_secondary: Unpacking the Links between Conflict and Child Health: Evidence from a Foreign Insurgency
authors: Heidi Kaila, Larissa Nawo, Hyuk Harry Son
official: 官方在线 2026-01-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Violent conflict has enduring effects on child health, but the speed at which these effects manifest is not fully understood. By use of data from a decade before to shortly after the Nigerian Boko Haram insurgency extended across the border to Cameroon, this study investigates the immediate effects of a deteriorating security environment caused by foreign-born insurgent terrorism on children’s health. Boko Haram attacks decrease weight-for-height for children under 5 years—an indicator of short-term health and nutrition—within an average of 2.6 months after the attacks. This effect is likely driven by a reduction in health-care service utilization, which can exacerbate the prevalence and the severity of conditions such as fever and diarrhea. However, the attacks do not affect dietary diversity or child mortality. The results underscore the importance of maintaining accessibility to health-care service after the start of terrorist violence to prevent irreversible effects, a concern that is increasingly relevant for countries combating the infiltration of foreign terrorists.
abstract_zh: 暴力冲突对儿童健康具有持久影响，但这些影响显现的速度尚未完全明了。本研究利用尼日利亚博科圣地叛乱跨越边境蔓延至喀麦隆前后十年的数据，探讨了由外国出生的叛乱恐怖主义导致的安全环境恶化对儿童健康的即时影响。博科圣地袭击在平均2.6个月内降低了5岁以下儿童的体重-身高比——这是衡量短期健康和营养状况的指标。这一效应很可能源于医疗服务利用的减少，这可能会加剧发烧和腹泻等疾病的患病率及严重程度。然而，袭击并未影响饮食多样性或儿童死亡率。研究结果强调了在恐怖暴力开始后保持医疗服务可及性的重要性，以防止不可逆的影响，这对于正在应对外国恐怖分子渗透的国家而言日益相关。
